grades.lower_bound_mechanism: immediate-win lemma (angle 2θ) plus dyadic ladder; θ=90° base proven, ladder step invalid
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: acute-triangle defense for θ>90°; unproven finite-lattice invariant for 180k/2ⁿ
grades.notes: Correct: one-move win iff an angle is 2θ; θ=90° win proven; θ>90° acute defense essentially proven. Ladder step 'both children get 2θ' is false for θ<45°, so 22.5° etc. unproven; 60°, 30° wrongly excluded. Lattice invariant for 180k/2ⁿ breaks under arbitrary cuts. Conjectured answer 180°/2ⁿ misses all 180/n with n≥3.
